events.title: Uncharted: music therapy and support workshop for navigating uncertainty.
events.description:
For anyone navigating grief, illness, identity, isolation, or change. A space to create, reflect, and learn. No music experience needed. 
          Uncharted is a monthly online workshop series for anyone moving through an uncertain season of life. This workshop is particularly suited for processing grief, illness, a diagnosis, unmasking, a relationship ending, a career shifting, or just not knowing what comes next in life. 
          Each session brings together music, conversation, and reflection to help you process what can't always be put into words. 
          We learn about and take inspiration from composers like John Cage, Pauline Oliveros, Morton Feldman, Steve Reich, and Cornelius Cardew. 
          Artists who each and in their own ways explored change and indeterminacy. We bring that same spirit into how we approach life.

events.title: Neurodivergent Music Therapy: Song Sharing and Discussion - Holiday Season
events.description: 'Tis the season for sharing and connection! Join our festive open discussion for music lovers. We'll listen to holiday tunes and heartwarming songs, and talk about the memories and feelings they evoke. Share a song that defines your holiday season—whether it's classic carols, festive pop, or a wintery ballad—and tell us the story behind it.
